text:
Maya: Heads-up — PR #4238 is ready for a quick pre-cut smoke review. Cut is in ~3 hours. Can someone take a 10–15m look? Link: https://git.redwood/infra/pr/4238 :eyes:

Tim: taking it now, will run the smoke locally and post results.

Jon: I can review the code. Quick Q — does this require a backport to 1.18?

Sandeep: yes, needs a 1.18 backport (runtime bugfix). I can prep the backport PR after main merges.

Maya: thanks. Main changes: batching/kvcache tweak, fallback routing tweak, and minor changelog text. No schema changes.

Tim: smoke results: local perf looks good, no regressions on p50/p95. small log spam in debug.

Tim: attaching command I used to smoke:```bash
./scripts/smoke_test.sh --pr 4238 --seq 512 --timeout 300
```

Eva: looks fine to me at a glance. Jon do you want me to validate the changelog text?

Jon: yeah please, Eva. Maya can you add the changelog label so it doesn't get missed in the cut?

Maya: done — added labels: `changelog/patch`, `backport/1.18`, `release-candidate`. Assigned Jon and Tim as reviewers.

deploy-bot: Release cut window scheduled at 2026-03-17T19:00:00Z — auto-merge will trigger at cut if PR has `release-candidate` + 2 approvals.

Jon: code review comments posted — one small nits + a question about the kv eviction threshold. Nothing blocking.

Sandeep: I'll open the backport PR after merge and ping eng-releases for verification. Command I'll use:```bash
git checkout -b backport/1.18/pr-4238
git cherry-pick -x <commit>
# push and open PR with label backport/1.18
```

Tim: gave a :shipit: after the tiny log spam note (non-blocking).

Maya: ok, summary: Tim smoke ✅, Jon code review ✅ (non-blocking), labels added, Sandeep will backport. Plan to merge ~15m before cut unless anyone yells. Thanks all :tada:

Jon: quick follow-up — adding one tiny test to cover kv edge-case, will send separate PR if flaky. Not blocking this merge.

Maya: merging now — will watch canary metrics and revert if anything weird.

deploy-bot: PR #4238 merged at 1772457450 by Maya (auto-merge). Canary rollout started.

Tim: watching metrics, no errors so far.

Maya: closing thread — will post if canary shows regressions. Thanks everyone! :raised_hands:
